40021896.author: पदार्थः
40021896.content: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, निशम्य having heard, परमाद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful, सुप्रीतः very pleased, च and, अभवत् became, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् word, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40021896.author: Translation
40021896.content: Having heard that exceedingly wonderful speech of Lakshmana, Rama became very pleased and indeed spoke these words.

40021897.author: पदार्थः
40021897.content: दुर्लभः rare, तु indeed, ईदृशः such, बन्धुः a kinsman, अस्मिन् काले in this time, विशेषतः especially, यादृशः such as, त्वम् you, महाबुद्धेः O greatly intelligent one, मम my, सौम्य O gentle one, मनः अनुगः following the mind.

40021897.author: Translation
40021897.content: Indeed, such a kinsman as you, O greatly intelligent and gentle one, who follows my mind, is rare to find, especially in these times.

40021898.author: पदार्थः
40021898.content: यत् what, च and, मे my, हृदये in the heart, किञ्चित् something, वर्तते exists, शुभलक्षण O one with auspicious marks, तत् that, निशामय listen carefully, च and, श्रुत्वा having heard, कुरुष्व do, वचनम् command, मम my.

40021898.author: Translation
40021898.content: O one with auspicious marks, listen carefully to what is in my heart, and having heard it, carry out my command.

40021899.author: पदार्थः
40021899.content: चत्वारो four, दिवसाः days, सौम्य O gentle one, कार्यं work, पौरजनस्य of the citizens, वै indeed, अकुर्वाणस्य of one who neglects, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, तत् that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts.

40021899.author: Translation
40021899.content: O gentle Lakshmana, the neglect of the citizens' work for four days indeed pierces my vital parts.

40021900.author: पदार्थः
40021900.content: आहूयन्तां let them be called, प्रकृतयः the principal officers, पुरोधा the chief priest, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, तथा and, कार्यार्थिनः those seeking justice, च and, पुरुषाः men, स्त्रियः women, च and, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40021900.author: Translation
40021900.content: O best among men, let the principal officers, the chief priest, the ministers, and also the men and women seeking justice be summoned.

40021901.author: पदार्थः
40021901.content: पौरकार्याणि the affairs of the citizens, यः who, राजा king, न not, करोति does, दिने दिने day by day, संवृते in an enclosed, नरके hell, घोरे terrible, पतितः fallen, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.

40021901.author: Translation
40021901.content: There is no doubt that a king who does not attend to the affairs of his citizens daily falls into a terrible, enclosed hell.

40021902.author: पदार्थः
40021902.content: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, राजा king, नृगः Nṛga, नाम named, महायशाः very famous, बभूव was, पृथिवीपालः a protector of the earth, ब्रह्मण्यः devoted to Brahmins, सत्यवाक् truthful, शुचिः pure.

40021902.author: Translation
40021902.content: Indeed, it is heard that formerly there was a very famous king named Nṛga, a protector of the earth, who was devoted to Brahmins, truthful, and pure.

40021903.author: पदार्थः
40021903.content: सः he, कदाचित् once, गवां of cows, कोटीः crores, सवत्साः with their calves, स्वर्णभूषिताः adorned with gold, नृदेवः the king, भूमिदेवेभ्यः to the Brahmins, पुष्करेषु at Pushkara, ददौ gave, नृपः the king.

40021903.author: Translation
40021903.content: That king, Nṛga, once at Pushkara, gave crores of cows, along with their calves and adorned with gold, to the Brahmins.

40021904.author: पदार्थः
40021904.content: ततः then, सङ्गात् from association, गता went, धेनुः the cow, सवत्सा with its calf, स्पर्शिता touched/taken, अनघ O sinless one, ब्राह्मणस्य of a Brahmana, आहिताग्नेः who maintains sacred fires, च and, दरिद्रस्य of a poor man, उञ्छवर्तिनः who lives by gleaning,

40021904.author: Translation
40021904.content: O sinless one, then that cow with its calf, having come into contact, was taken by a poor Brahmana who maintained sacred fires and lived by gleaning.

40021905.author: पदार्थः
40021905.content: सः he, नष्टां lost, गां cow, क्षुधार्तः afflicted by hunger, वै indeed, अन्विषन् searching, तत्र तत्र here and there, च and, न not, अपश्यत् saw, सर्वराज्येषु in all kingdoms, संवत्सरगणान् groups of years, बहून् many,

40021905.author: Translation
40021905.content: Afflicted by hunger, he searched for his lost cow here and there in all kingdoms for many years but could not find it.

40021906.author: पदार्थः
40021906.content: ततः then, कनखलं to Kanakhala, गत्वा having gone, जीर्णवत्सां whose calf was old, निरामयाम् healthy, ददर्श he saw, गां the cow, स्वकां his own, धेनुं cow, ब्राह्मणस्य of the Brahmana, निवेशने in the dwelling,

40021906.author: Translation
40021906.content: Then, having gone to Kanakhala, he saw his own cow, whose calf had grown old and was healthy, in the dwelling of the Brahmana.

40021907.author: पदार्थः
40021907.content: अथ then, तां her, नामधेयेन by name, स्वकेन his own, उवाच said, सः that, द्विजः Brahmana, आगच्छ come, शबलेति O Shabala, एवं thus, सा she, तु indeed, शुश्राव heard, गौः the cow, स्वरम् the voice,

40021907.author: Translation
40021907.content: Then that Brahmana called her by her own name, saying, "Come, Shabala!" and the cow indeed heard his voice.

40021908.author: पदार्थः
40021908.content: तस्य his, तं that, स्वरं voice, आज्ञाय having recognized, क्षुधार्तस्य of the hungry, द्विजस्य Brahmana, वै indeed, अन्वगात् followed, पृष्ठतः from behind, सा she, गौः the cow, गच्छन्तं him who was going, पावकोपमम् like fire,

40021908.author: Translation
40021908.content: Having recognized the voice of that hungry Brahmana, the cow indeed followed him from behind as he, radiant like fire, walked away.

40021909.author: पदार्थः
40021909.content: यः who, अपि also, पालयते protects, विप्रः brahmin, सः he, अपि also, गाम् cow, अन्वगात् followed, द्रुतम् quickly, गत्वा having gone, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, आचष्ट told, मम my, गौः cow, इति thus, सत्वरम् quickly.

40021909.author: Translation
40021909.content: The brahmin who was tending the cow also quickly followed it, and having gone, swiftly told that sage, "This is my cow."

40021910.author: पदार्थः
40021910.content: स्पर्शिता touched, राजसिंहेन by the lion among kings, मम my, दत्ता given, नृगेण by Nṛga, ह indeed, तयोः of those two, ब्राह्मणयोः brahmins, वादः dispute, महान् great, आसीत् was, विपश्चितोः learned.

40021910.author: Translation
40021910.content: One brahmin claimed the cow was touched by the king, while the other insisted it was given to him by Nṛga, leading to a great dispute between the two learned brahmins.

40021911.author: पदार्थः
40021911.content: विवदन्तौ disputing, ततः then, अन्योन्यम् each other, दातारम् the giver, अभिजग्मतुः approached, तौ those two, राजभवनद्वारि at the palace gate, न not, प्राप्तौ obtained, नृगशासनम् Nṛga's command.

40021911.author: Translation
40021911.content: Then, disputing with each other, they approached the giver (King Nṛga), but those two did not meet King Nṛga at the palace gate.

40021912.author: पदार्थः
40021912.content: अहोरात्राणि days and nights, अनेकानि many, वसन्तौ staying, क्रोधम् anger, ईयतुः reached, ऊचतुः spoke, च and, महात्मानौ great-souled ones, तौ those, उभौ both, द्विजसत्तमौ best among brahmins, क्रुद्धौ angry, परमसम्प्राप्तौ having reached the highest, वाक्यम् words, घोराभिसंहितम् terrible and connected.

40021912.author: Translation
40021912.content: After staying for many days and nights, those two great-souled and best among brahmins became exceedingly angry and spoke terrible words filled with a curse.

40021913.author: पदार्थः
40021913.content: अर्थिनाम् of petitioners, कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् for the accomplishment of their purpose, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, न not, एषि go, दर्शनम् sight, अदृश्यः invisible, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, कृकलासः a chameleon, भविष्यसि you will become.

40021913.author: Translation
40021913.content: Because you do not grant an audience to petitioners for the accomplishment of their purpose, you shall become a chameleon, invisible to all beings.

40021914.author: पदार्थः
40021914.content: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, बहुवर्षशतानि many hundreds of years, च and, श्वभ्रे in this pit, अस्मिन् this, कृकलासो a chameleon, वै indeed, दीर्घकालं for a long time, वसिष्यसि you will reside.

40021914.author: Translation
40021914.content: For many thousands and hundreds of years, you will indeed reside in this pit as a chameleon for a long duration.

40021915.author: पदार्थः
40021915.content: उत्पत्स्यते will be born, हि indeed, लोके in the world, अस्मिन् this, यदूनां of the Yadus, कीर्तिवर्धनः increaser of fame, वासुदेव Vasudeva, इति thus named, ख्यातो renowned, विष्णुः Vishnu, पुरुषविग्रहः having a human form.

40021915.author: Translation
40021915.content: Indeed, in this world, Vishnu, renowned as Vasudeva, the increaser of the Yadus' glory and having a human form, will be born.

40021916.author: पदार्थः
40021916.content: स He, ते your, मोक्षयिता liberator, राजंस् O King, तस्मात् from that, शापात् curse, भविष्यसि you will be, कृता done, च and, तेन by him, कालेन by time, निष्कृतिस् expiation, ते your, भविष्यति will be.

40021916.author: Translation
40021916.content: O King, he will be your liberator from that curse, and by him, your expiation will be accomplished in due course.

40021917.author: पदार्थः
40021917.content: भारावतरणार्थं for the purpose of alleviating the burden, हि indeed, नरनारायणौ Nara and Narayana, उभौ both, उत्पत्स्येते will be born, महावीर्यौ greatly powerful, कलौ in the Kali, युगे in the age, उपस्थिते when it has arrived.

40021917.author: Translation
40021917.content: Indeed, both Nara and Narayana, greatly powerful, will be born for the purpose of alleviating the earth's burden when the Kali Yuga has arrived.

40021918.author: पदार्थः
40021918.content: एवं thus, तौ those two, शापम् curse, उत्सृज्य having uttered, ब्राह्मणौ the two Brahmins, विगतज्वरौ free from distress, तां that, गां cow, हि indeed, दुर्बलां weak, वृद्धां old, ददतुर् they gave, ब्राह्मणाय to a Brahmin, वै indeed.

40021918.author: Translation
40021918.content: Thus, having pronounced the curse, those two Brahmins, now free from distress, indeed gave that weak, old cow to a Brahmin.

40021919.author: पदार्थः
40021919.content: एवं thus, सः that, राजा king, तम् that, शापम् curse, उपभुङ्क्ते experiences, सुदारुणम् very terrible.

40021919.author: Translation
40021919.content: In this manner, that king experiences that very terrible curse.

40021920.author: पदार्थः
40021920.content: कार्यार्थिनाम् of those seeking their purpose, विमर्दः crowding, हि indeed, राज्ञाम् for kings, दोषाय for harm, कल्पते leads to, तत् therefore, शीघ्रम् quickly, दर्शनम् audience, मह्यम् to me, अभिवर्तन्तु let them approach, कार्यिणः petitioners.

40021920.author: Translation
40021920.content: Indeed, the crowding of petitioners leads to harm for kings; therefore, let the petitioners quickly approach me for an audience.

40021921.author: पदार्थः
40021921.content: सुकृतस्य of a well-done, हि indeed, कार्यस्य of work, फलम् the fruit, न not, अपैति is lost, पार्थिवः O king, तस्मात् therefore, गच्छ go, प्रतीक्षस्व wait, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, कार्यवान् one who has business, जनः person.

40021921.author: Translation
40021921.content: Indeed, the fruit of a well-done work is not lost, O king; therefore, O son of Sumitra, go and wait for any person who has business. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 53 ।। Thus ends the fifty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
